answer.note: For a 3-person household, $62,000 gross annual household income is above the $54,640 CARE ceiling but at or below the $68,300 FERA ceiling. No categorical-program path is indicated because no public-program enrollment was supplied. This is only a preliminary eligibility screen under the snapshot effective June 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027; it is not enrollment or an official decision.
